concerns.text: FR‑001 requires a fallback that generates a descriptive preliminary report when fewer than 10 usable samples are obtained. No task in `tasks.md` implements this fallback logic or the associated reporting step.

FR‑007 mandates a co‑location validation step to verify that each EDS map and its performance record originate from the same device. No task explicitly performs or verifies this validation (the plan mentions a `co_location.py` script but no corresponding task is defined).

FR‑009 requires estimation of charge‑carrier diffusion lengths (from TRPL data or an empirical calibration) and inclusion of this predictor in the statistical modeling. No task addresses diffusion‑length estimation or the creation of a `diffusion_lengths.csv` artifact.

FR‑010 calls for a linearity diagnostic (residual‑vs‑fitted plots and lack‑of‑fit test) before reporting Pearson results. The current tasks (T005, T006) compute Pearson/Spearman but do not include any linearity‑check step.

SC‑004 specifies that the data‑ingestion success rate must be ≥ 95 %. Task T002 produces `ingestion_stats.json` but the verification checklist does not assert that the success rate meets the 95 % threshold.
The data model defines a `DiffusionLength` entity, yet no task creates or populates this entity, leaving the model element uncovered.
